translation:
Taking Asahina with me, I came to ask more
questions of the Computer Research Society.
Eeek…

There was a strange tension among the
members who stood before us.

We don't have anything else to tell you. Can't
you leave us be?

He's as blunt as a pheasant… Actually, where
does that expression even come from?

I'm sure Koizumi would spill his vast knowledge
if I asked him.

I'd rather avoid that turn of events, so I'll
turn my attention back to the club president.

Don't be like that. I'd just like to ask more
questions.

There isn't anything you didn't tell Haruhi,
right?

There's nothing! We've told you everything we
know!

Besides, getting involved with you lot is never
a good idea.
Could you stop interfering with our work?

U-um, please, we beg you for even a little bit
of your time.
[#SK0Wha]?! D-don't get so close!

The moment Asahina asked, the club president
recoiled in fear.

It seems like he's still reeling from what
happened in the past…

When that happened, the true victim was
Asahina, you bastard!

Committing the unforgivable sin of touching
Asahina's chest. Unbelievable…
You should be thankful you're still healthy.

Though, it can't be denied that he's the victim
of Haruhi's scheme.
Kyon…

In response to the president's refusal,
Asahina's eyes clung to me.
Let's get straight out of here, Asahina.

After suggesting a tactical retreat, Asahina
nodded with relief.

Um, we're very sorry for intruding, people of
the computer society.
If you can help it, don't come here.
Ohh… But…
[#SK0Agh]!

Stay in there, Prez! Don't be seduced by her
womanly charms!

R-r-r-r-r-right, of course! Those eyes won't
work on me!

If any more of our newest PCs are taken by
your brigade chief, it'd be a nightmare!
I'm sorry… It's my fault, isn't it…
That's not true, Asahina!

It is. It's because of me that the members of
the computer society are so on edge.

That's absolutely not true. The reason
they're so wary is because of Haruhi.

I definitely want Asahina to know the
difference.

Rather than discussing it here, why don't we
head back to the clubroom and think it over?
…I suppose.
Oh right…

Since we're going back to the clubroom, I hope
I can drink your delicious tea.

Asahina flashed me a delightful smile in
response to my words.

Of course. I'll do my best to brew the best tea
I can make.

If it weren't an emergency, I'd happily enjoy
the bliss of drinking tea with you, Asahina.

As it stands, we're unfortunately in a tight
spot right now, so it's not so easy.

For now, we just want information, right? I
don't want to hear their scary stories, but…

It would be a disaster if Suzumiya saw the
strange occurrence you did…

We somehow need to get more details from the
computer society if we're going to get ahead.
I've just become a hindrance to you.

I mean, I'm not as capable as Nagato or
Koizumi, and stuff.
…I can't do anything.

More than that, because of me we can't ask
them any more questions…

Asahina is clearly unaware that she's the
SOS Brigade's indispensable shining angel.
She's seriously depressed.

If only Haruhi could pick up that restraint
from Asahina.
It's not your fault at all.
Because of you, I get to drink delicious tea.
Kyon… Thank you.

Though, I'm not sure how we should conquer
the computer society…
How about I go ask them alone?
…I am a hindrance, after all.
Wait, actually let's go together.

I make a flustered attempt to take back the
tears gradually building up in her eyes.

I had a heartbreaking self-reflection on how
horrible I was to upset Asahina like that.
…Right! Tea! Tea!

How about you deliver them some exquisite
tea?

Okay. I guess that's something even I can do,
right?

Not at all. This is something that only you can
do, Asahina.
How about bringing them some tea relief?
Relief?

Your deliciously brewed tea may serve to
relax them and sooth the tension.

They would really be less wary from something
so trivial?

Us SOS Brigade members are used to this level
of luxury, unlike the computer folks.
I answered proudly.
Eh? Luxury?

She really has no awareness of what she
does for us. Well, that's very like her I suppose.

Even though I told you not to come here. You
folks really are shameless.
Well, never mind that. How about some tea?

Um, I don't know what tea you like, so it was
quite hard to choose, but…

I went for berry tea, since I thought it might
be good for tired eyes.

And since you're all thinking a lot, I thought
maybe it would be best to add some sugar.

I'll try to sweeten it up a little with some maple
syrup.

Relief from eyestrain and nourishment for the
brain…?

Asahina brought some freshly brewed tea for
you.
You don't need it?

You all look tired, so would you like to take a
little rest?
A-ah…

The SOS Brigade's oasis: Asahina's smiling
face and the tea she brewed with love.

These melted the stubbornness of the Com-
puter Society like spring on a snowy mountain.
…Let's take a break.
So, about class 1-10…

Oh! This berry tea is delicious! It feels like my
head is being cleared!
Thank you very much.

Thanks to you, I feel like we can make an
amazing game!
Ehh?! You're making a game?

Oops, I didn't mean to let that slip! Don't tell
anyone!
Ah, okay. It's a secret. I understand.

But, you can really make a game just by
yourselves? That's amazing.

Well, it's impossible if you aren't as skilled as
we are.

As I said, I want to know more details about
the class 1-10 that shouldn't exist…
Even with the skills it's a huge undertaking.

In any case, everything in the game is orig-
inal. We're not using any pre-existing engine.

E-engine? That's different from what makes
a car move, right?

Hahaha, well of course! Aren't you an amusing
one.
Huh… I'm sorry I don't know much.

Not at all! On the contrary, it's pleasantly
refreshing!

Could we quickly get to the matter of class
1-10…
What kind of games do you like, Asahina?
Huh? Me?

You ask what kind, but I haven't really played
any…

He's completely forgotten about his fears
from earlier, and now won't leave Asahina alone.

I guess this leaves me with only one option. I'm
gonna say it.
Asahina hates games, you know.
Eh?
Really?

So I don't think it's nice to force her to talk
about them.

It's true that I don't know much about
machines, but I wouldn't say I hate them…

Asahina said so as if she knew how the
shocked club president was going to react.

I'm surprised people like that still exist in
Japan, the great country of games!

You probably qualify as a failure of a
Japanese citizen!
That's a little extreme…
Huh?! I-I'm a failure…of a Japanese citizen?

Asahina took it seriously and appeared
dumbfounded. What a pure-hearted person!
I'm sorry for hurting you…

All I mean is that games aren't Asahina's cup
of tea.

She's probably troubled by being forced to
talk about this topic.
Is that so?
Ah, yes… That's how I feel.
She gave a sincere nod.

I thought that was the case, and it seems
I've hit the nail on the head.
I don't know much about machines, and stuff…

Also my reflexes are bad so I can't follow
games…

That's perfectly fine. Not all games require
good reflexes.
How about I teach you about games?
T-thank you very much.
Damn it. My plan to shift the topic failed.

You're completely different from your brigade
chief, aren't you?

I'm not thrilled that he assumes we're just all
like Haruhi.

On the other hand, I also don't like him
becoming overly obsessed with Asahina.

Especially as the president has a mark in his
criminal record for crimes against Asahina.

I really envy you. You could say I'm jealous,
even.

The computer society members nodded in
unison. This lack of progress is killing me.

Even now, unbeknownst to everyone, the
world is in danger… Probably.

How about you leave that dreadful brigade
chief's brigade, and come join us, Asahina?

Hold on, what did you just say? She's the SOS
Brigade's sole oasis!

Even if Koizumi says it's fine, Nagato would
say nothing, and I would give a firm NO.

There's no way Haruhi would allow that in the
first place.

According to Haruhi, Asahina is the SOS
Brigade's mascot, after all.

I wonder what Haruhi will do when she finds out
you said that…

At the name Haruhi, the president's face went
pale. Is now good to say serves you right?

If you want to try scouting Asahina, try
again in 100 years.

We won't hand her over to the computer
society.
Asahina is the SOS Brigade's angel.

Then we'll worship her as our goddess! Day or
night, we shall bow down in gratitude!

Please stop being creepy. The only one who'd
want to be bowed down to is Haruhi.

Um… I don't feel like quitting the SOS Brigade.
I'm sorry.
…I see.

There's no way she'll be the computer
society's goddess.

Asahina's mission is to observe Haruhi. She
can't quit.

I wish I could say she's with us because she
wants to be, though.

Thank you for giving up on recruiting her so
quickly.

After that, the computer society president
and members…
…Didn't leave us alone for a while.
Really? That sounds reeaally tough.

Oh my. You're the only one who understands
us.

It sounds like tough work. Good luck, and
please try your best.
Indeed. We will do the best we can.
It's amazing. I really respect it.
R-respect… Wow. How wonderful!
Good grief…

We heard three times more complaining and
boasting than information about class 1-10.
That was probably a waste of time.
I'll go alone.
Bring them tea
She hates games.
She's not good with games.
Haruhi won't forgive you.
As if we'll hand her over to you.
